head.title: Cheeba Chews® Sativa Taffy Chocolate Cannabis for Sale in NJ
head.description: Introducing the Sativa Taffy Chocolate by Cheeba Chews, a delightful fusion of flavor and euphoria that promises to elevate your cannabis experience. Available at Highway 90, this exquisite edible combines the craftsmanship of Cheeba Chews with the rich, earthy allure of the Chocolate strain. Known for its balanced effects, Chocolate offers a harmonious blend of relaxation and euphoria, making it the perfect companion for both novice and seasoned users. With subtle hints of cocoa, this strain melts away stress while enhancing creativity and focus, providing a smooth and uplifting experience that’s as satisfying as it is indulgent.Edibles have become a beloved choice for cannabis enthusiasts seeking a discreet and convenient way to enjoy their favorite plant. Infused with cannabis extracts, these products offer a longer-lasting and often more intense experience compared to other consumption methods. The Sativa Taffy Chocolate by Cheeba Chews is no exception. As it is metabolized through the digestive system, this delectable treat provides a delayed onset of effects, typically ranging from 30 minutes to 2 hours. This makes it important for consumers to start with a low dose and be patient, ensuring a pleasurable and controlled experience.Since 2009, Cheeba Chews has been a trusted name in cannabis-infused edibles, renowned for their hand-crafted taffy, consistent dosing, and delicious flavors. Whether you’re seeking THC, CBD, or a mix of both, Cheeba Chews offers something for everyone. Their commitment to quality and innovation has made them a favorite among cannabis connoisseurs seeking a sweet escape.Highway 90 isn’t just a dispensary—it’s a destination. Conveniently located at 90 Old Marlton Pike W in Marlton, NJ, our shop sits at the crossroads of Route 70 and Route 73, directly across from Marlton Crossing. Serving the communities of Evesham, Cherry Hill, Voorhees Township, Medford, and Mt. Laurel, we make it easy for cannabis enthusiasts across the region to find high-quality products in a welcoming and inviting environment. At Highway 90, we believe that cannabis is personal, and our knowledgeable team is here to ensure you get exactly what you need. Whether you’re looking for top-shelf flower, potent concentrates, delicious edibles, or soothing topicals, we have the perfect selection to elevate your experience.From seasoned connoisseurs to first-time buyers, our commitment to quality, education, and exceptional service makes us Marlton’s go-to recreational dispensary. Conveniently accessible from Cherry Hill and Philadelphia, Highway 90 offers a seamless shopping experience, competitive pricing, and a selection curated with care. Stop by today and experience the Highway 90 difference—where quality meets community, and every visit is unforgettable. Highway 90 is the closest dispensary to the AMC 8, Chickie's & Pete's, and The Promenade.Elevate your experience with the uplifting effects of Sativa Chocolate Chews. Crafted for moments of creativity, energy, and connection, each chew helps you find your spark and embrace brighter days. Savor the rich chocolate flavor as you unlock your potential.Cannabis chocolates are popular because the dominant chocolate flavor overpowers the "green" taste you may find in other edibles. Because edibles are digested and absorbed by your stomach and liver, the activation is often longer than other consumption methods, taking on average 45 minutes, and sometimes up to 2 hours. It is important to start low and slow when consuming edibles so you don't over do it. Take extra caution to ensure edibles are out of the reach of children.
